input.quote: NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, PUNITIVE, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES OR LOST PROFITS ARISING FROM OR RELATING TO ANY BREACH OF THIS AGREEMENT, REGARDLESS OF ANY NOTICE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
input.rationale: Section 14.5 is the only limitation-of-liability provision in the Agreement (Article XIV otherwise deals with indemnity, mitigation and insurance; Section 14.6 confirms insurance creates no liability limit, and Section 15.6(a) only bars punitive awards in arbitration). It contains a mutual waiver of consequential, incidental, punitive and indirect damages, but no aggregate monetary cap of any kind, so each Party's direct liability is unlimited. That fails the fallback on two material terms: there is no mutual aggregate cap and no 12-months-of-fees basis. The existing carve-out sentence already places indemnification obligations under Sections 14.1/14.2 and confidentiality breaches under Article XI outside anything in Section 14.5, so those fallback carve-outs are met; gross negligence and willful misconduct were not carved out. We therefore added a single sentence inside Section 14.5 setting a mutual cap at the amounts paid or payable by Sanofi in the twelve months preceding the claim, expressly subject to the existing carve-outs and with gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped. We targeted the fallback and did not add the USD 1,000,000 floor, data-protection, fraud or payment-obligation elements.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.

mappings.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2

mappings.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
mappings.quote: OR DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY UNDER ARTICLE X.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-month payments cap to Section 14.5, with gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped alongside the existing indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.5 waives consequential damages but sets no monetary cap, so both parties' direct liability is unlimited; we added a mutual cap of the amounts payable by Sanofi in the preceding twelve months. Indemnification and confidentiality claims remain uncapped under the existing carve-out sentence, and we expressly kept gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.

ops.text: Subject to the foregoing, and except in the case of a Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the amounts paid or payable by Sanofi under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.
